firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently sacrificed something receives the starting-player marker.
officialTieBreak: If tied, give the marker to the player who volunteers for the next sacrifice.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The marker holder takes the first turn; play proceeds clockwise.

The marker does not rotate automatically between rounds. Placing a worker on the Starting Player Space changes its holder at the end of the round: take it from another player, or pass it left if you already hold it.
The thematic instruction does not define what counts as a sacrifice.
